title: WorkflowDefinition
description: Defines a named, versioned workflow as a directed graph of agent nodes. Stored as YAML in recipes/workflows/; validated by mini-ork on load.

version.description: Semantic or sequential version string, e.g. '1.0.0' or '0009'.

task_class.description: The task_class this workflow serves (must match a task_class.schema.json name).

nodes.description: Agent nodes in this workflow. Each node maps to a single agent invocation.

edges.description: Directed edges connecting nodes. The graph must be a DAG (no cycles).

rollback_strategy.description: Name of the rollback node to invoke if a hard-fail gate fires. Must reference a node name with type 'rollback'.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this workflow accomplishes.

name.description: Unique node identifier within this workflow.

model_lane.description: Model or lane hint, e.g. 'opus', 'sonnet', 'haiku', 'glm', 'kimi'. Resolved against agent_version registry at runtime.

dispatch_mode.description: How this node's work units are dispatched: serial (one by one), parallel (all at once), partitioned (sharded by input key), speculative (race N copies; first wins).

gates.description: Gate IDs that must pass before this node is considered done. References registered_gates(gate_id).

prompt_ref.description: Path (relative to repo root) or key of the prompt template for this node.

timeout_minutes.description: Hard timeout for this node in minutes. 0 = inherit workflow default.

max_cost_usd.description: Per-invocation cost ceiling in USD. 0 = no per-node cap.

retries.description: How many times to retry this node on failure before escalating.

from.description: Source node name (must match a node.name in this workflow).

to.description: Target node name (must match a node.name in this workflow).

edge_type.description: Semantic relationship between from and to nodes.

condition.description: Optional CEL/shell expression that must evaluate to truthy for this edge to activate. Empty string = unconditional.
